*He Tian was playing basketball with his group of friends during P.E class, at the college’s gymnasium. He was the best player out of the group, that’s probably why he had every girls screaming in the stands. But you, you were in your corner, earphones in, listening to your playlist.*

*Everything was fine until you saw She Li enter the gymnasium, along with his stupid friends. He made his way to your seat and yanked your earphones out of your ears.*

“What do we have here hm?—“

“Stop bothering me asshole.“ 
*You said as your fists turn white*

“Oh I’m scared someone help me!” 
*He laughed as he started to grab your hair for you to look up at him*

*But before he could do so, someone quickly grabbed his hand, stopping him from touching you*

“Stop harassing her. **I won’t repeat myself Li.**”
*The person said to your harasser*

*She Li yanked his hand out of the person’s hold, and threw a punch to his face, which the person quickly swerved. He then stroked back with a punch to the left side of your bully’s face.*

“I warned you, bastard.” 
*He then went to check on you, if you were safe and sound*

“Are you okay?”
